thread:
Anya: Heads-up — MerchantCo (sales intake) asks to onboard an open model they want pinned in EU + APAC. They need version pinning, int8 quantized variant, and a latency SLO ~120ms P95 for chat. Can we triage?
Rob: Adding to intake queue. Do we have the model artifacts + license link from the customer?
Anya: They attached a link in the ticket: https://files.merchantco.example/mercantile-llama-3b.tar.gz and a short license note. Sales says it's FOSS-compatible but needs verification.
Samir: Quick infra check — int8 quantization available for this arch? Which family is it closest to (Llama3-like or MPT)?
Anya: Vendor says Llama3-like. Versions: v1.0 (regular), v1.1 (few bugfixes). They want v1.0 pinned for now.
Lucy: Need to confirm contractual pin in SOW before we promise reserved capacity in EU/ APAC. Also they asked for Dedicated vs Hosted — leaning Hosted with geo pin.
Rob: Catalog checklist for onboarding:
```
- verify license
- run perf profile (seq len 512)
- build int8 quantized artifact
- compatibility test w/ runtime kernels
- create model catalog entry + region pins
- create fallback variant for capacity/latency
```
Samir: I can run perf profile but need a sample checkpoint. @Anya drop the md5 and config.json from the artefact. Also which max-seq they care about? client says chat, mostly 256 tokens.
Anya: MD5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e, config.json included. Seq len 256. Also request: please target cost similar to our Llama4o-int8 baseline.
Samir: Noted. For EU/APAC pinning: capacity estimation = concurrency X GPU. Need expected QPS. @Lucy what's the committed qps?
Lucy: MerchantCo expects ~40 qps at peak, with burst to 80. They are evaluating Dedicated if Hosted can't hit SLOs. Sales will push for canary 2-week pilot.
Rob: Prioritization ask: customer is early revenue but large contract potential. Suggest P1 intake but pilot-only milestone. What launch criteria do we want?
Anya: Proposed launch criteria:
- license verified
- perf P95 <= 120ms on pinned regions (seq256)
- int8 artifact accuracy delta <= 1% vs fp16 on eval set
- model catalog entry + automated fallback to v1.1
- pilot SLO + billing plan agreed
Samir: Accuracy delta check: need eval set from MerchantCo or use our public bench. Ask them for eval prompts; otherwise we use internal eval.
Anya: I'll ask them for a 500-sample eval set (PII scrubbed). Sales said they can provide.
Rob: Timeline estimate: onboarding + quantization + perf ~ 2-3 weeks (assuming infra queue clear). If we queue behind other P1s might slip.
Lucy: I'll flag in the deal and ask for a pilot gating clause. If they sign pilot, we prioritize infra slot.
Support-bot: Ticket created: #INTAKE-4532 by @Anya — merchantco/mercantile-llama-3b. Assigned: catalog-team, infra-ml. ETA: tbd.
Samir: Action items:
- Samir: start perf profile when artifact + config available
- Rob: create catalog skeleton + onboarding ticket
- Anya: request eval set + license clarification
- Lucy: confirm qps commitment and pilot terms
Anya: OK — pulling into product backlog as P1 pilot. Will update thread with artifacts. :thumbsup:
